NOT launched, NOT chained.] THE CHANGE (bots/src/airpocket.mjs + reflex.mjs): a POSE-AWARE EYE (the server's pose datum when sent, else a collision model: stand 1.62 / crouch 1.27 / swim 0.4; the plan's base is the cell under the eye); an `up` route through a solid cell above that eye is `upblocked` (the rescue's scan starts above the head cell, so ice formed around a swimming bot read `up dist=1` -- 23 of 244 drownings since 10-01, all hive-d) and the step triggers on it after 8 s held and 4 s not closing (row `_air_pocket_upblocked`; the start row names pose= and blocked=); the dig is PRICED AND RUN with the pose's eye (mineflayer's finish timer would otherwise drop the 5x submerged penalty); SUCCESS = the pose-aware eye in air 2.5 s with NO health drop since the last drop and rising-or-max (Paper: airpocket-01 logged a false success on a refrozen cell); the step RE-DIGS a cell that re-forms (2 more, re-priced; exhausted = failed, 5-s cooldown); NEVER digs a trapdoor or a roof with one within 2 above (the junk well's floor). NOT in this build: the open-window equip race (a separate owner session owns it). Rows only this build writes: `_air_pocket_upblocked`, and start rows carrying ` pose=`.

licence.note: Written only by airpocket-02, once per trap detection (throttled 30 s per cell); the fleet (airpocket-01) never writes it. RATE: hive-d had 5.5 head-ice episodes/day on 5 bots (42 in 7.7 days, 24 ended in a drowning) and no other pool had any, so with hive-d drawn the row is expected ~0.7 times per 3 h: P(none by +180) ~ 50%, by +360 ~ 25%. A missing licence at the first read is the trap not occurring, not the code absent -- the extension to exposure covers it.

draw_exposure.note: Each drawn pool must have REAL sealed drownings (air out: the oxygen filter drops stuck full-oxygen bots, e.g. placebo-b's 27 ceilings at oxygen 20). On 10-07 13-20Z: hive-c, hive-d, hive-b, placebo-a, placebo-d qualify. CLAUDE.md: a canary pool must contain the population the fix targets. exposure.note: Ready = >= 1 MATURE canary attempt triggered `upblocked` (airpocket-02's own mechanism) AND both control instruments. Expected only with hive-d drawn: 5.5 trap episodes/day on its 5 bots, ~1-2 per 6 h; none elsewhere.

own_lines.note: C1: a canary _air_pocket success followed by the same bot's DROWNING death within 120 s.
C2: a lava/fire or suffocation death, or a lava danger-block row, within 30 s after any canary _air_pocket row.
C3: an attempt that did not succeed ending below 3 HP, or ANY death between its _air_pocket_start and _air_pocket rows (the 4 HP reserve must survive an abort).
C4: an attempt whose trigger_route is up (the swim was working).
C5: envelope 0.5 on a world that is not peaceful.

C0: an _air_pocket row with a missing/non-finite required field or no start row, or a start row with no end row while the bot kept logging for 120 s (unfinished). The gates above would read such rows as clean.
C6 (server-grounded false success): a canary success followed within 30 s by the same bot's _drowning_ceiling_no_air with no _drowning_breathing between (Paper freeze-probe trial 2's shape).
C7: an attempt triggered `upblocked` whose start row names no solid blocking cell (none, water, air): the step dug against a working up route.

Arms on what ONLY airpocket-02 writes (_air_pocket_upblocked rows, start rows with pose=): on the KEEP base the control runs airpocket-01 and writes _air_pocket* legitimately (reported as ap1_rows_control). BLOCKS KEEP.
POSITIVE CONTROL: the control's no-air sealed ceilings (oxygen <= 0) are visible. BLOCKS KEEP.
A KEEP needs >= 1 canary success: attempts that never work are INCONCLUSIVE, not a pass. BLOCKS KEEP (INCONCLUSIVE).
POSITIVE CONTROL: the control's capped rescues (_drowning_route sealed/unscanned/out) are visible. BLOCKS KEEP.

harm.note: Gate v34 (underground_safety): HYB@2.5, DiD of death rates against each arm's own 24-h PRE OR the matched pools, two-death floor, mechanism linkage by link_rules. The draw is biased toward drowning pools by design; hive-d alone drowns ~3/day in this trap.

teardown.note: THREE STEPS: drop-ins, clear canary_pool, restart the pool's bots 12 s apart; then confirm the live versions. Bots dig roof cells and place 1-3 scaffold blocks in survival; no admin world state is created.

extension.note: Short canary for a fix-shaped change (owner 2026-09-29).

link_rules.note: a death DURING the step (no end row of the same id before it): C3

a death within 120 s after an attempt is linked, EXCEPT a drowning after an aborted/failed/opened attempt that ended at >= 3 HP (the reserve held -- the read's C3 is clean -- the base-rate drowning the fix could not prevent); after a success/opened, after an attempt that spent the reserve, or any non-drowning death, it is linked
a death after the step pre-empted an escape and no step followed: the pre-empt itself

underground_safety.note: Gate v34 (docs/reports/usafe-death-gate-2026-10-08.md): the death gate is a DiD of death rates, each arm against its own 24-h PRE, OR the matched-pool control (HYB@2.5, operator + Codex 10-08), at the calibrated threshold in usaferule.py, because this canary is DRAWN on the pools that drown.
